brief: An 8-second piece where a concert poster for "Night Market, 12 June" comes alive and its elements break out of the poster frame before settling back into place.
notes: The headline (cream, ~23 units wide) overflowed its w:21 accent block in every settled frame and read as near-invisible cream-on-cream; I widened the block to w:26 so it fully backs the headline, killing the measured crossing and giving the headline a blue ground for contrast. The date was measured at 9 px, so I raised it from 2.6 to 3.4 (~12 px). The sub line was measured at 5 px and can't grow on one line inside the poster, so I split 'LIVE MUSIC / STREET FOOD' onto two lines and raised it from 1.3 to 3.0 (~10 px) within a widened w:26 box; I left the deliberate break-out crossings at 3.68 s alone since they are the requested effect.
